authority_note: Selections and maintained contracts are cited; rationale marked as synthesis in guides is not an invented owner quotation. Delivery/activation is separately qualified.

decisions.title: Incremental reusable ecosystem; Missoula first
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Build modular tournament capabilities with Missoula as the integration testbed from the outset, preserving the live show and STRATHEX retro CLI.
decisions.rationale: The owner explicitly approved reuse and implementation through a working host rather than another planning/decision-list exercise.
decisions.consequences: Implement/test real vertical workflows; preserve existing behavior and prove a second synthetic show before claiming real multi-show adapters.

decisions.title: Component ownership
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: MNEMEX owns person identity/consent/cross-show provenance; STRATHMARK owns predictions and delegated single-event operations; hosts own registration, whole-show scheduling, points and payouts.
decisions.rationale: The approved boundaries keep source authority and presentation separate while making components reusable.
decisions.consequences: No show DB writes from MNEMEX, no payout logic in shared calculations and no duplicate advancement algorithms in UI adapters.

decisions.title: Two explicit integration modes
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Support calculation-only and explicitly delegated operations. A calculation-only host retains event workflow authority; delegated events use STRATHMARK operational state.
decisions.rationale: Getting a prediction is a different act from delegating review, issue and advancement.
decisions.consequences: Never infer authority transfer from a calculation response or silently opt an existing event into managed mode.

decisions.title: One shared operational core
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: CLI, optional shared GUI, Missoula adapter and STRATHEX managed presentation call the same event operations.
decisions.rationale: The owner wants interchangeable presentation without rebuilding domain algorithms or context.
decisions.consequences: Keep fields, review, issue, correction, progression, source receipts and invariants in shared operations, not wrappers.

decisions.title: Real standalone operator-supplied-data CLI
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Provide a standalone installed CLI accepting user event configuration and numeric requests, not only generated demos or a Missoula wrapper.
decisions.rationale: Independent installed use proves the modular component is reusable beyond one host.
decisions.consequences: Core install imports neither host nor MNEMEX; examples are optional labeled synthetic inputs.

decisions.title: Optional shared GUI
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: The shared GUI is optional, authenticated and backed by the same operations/history as CLI, with explicit editor handover.
decisions.rationale: Operators can change interface without creating a second authority or numerical implementation.
decisions.consequences: Protect accounts/sessions/CSRF, default to loopback, review exact sheet digests and never treat GUI availability as engine qualification.

decisions.title: Explicit immutable root selection; no engine fallback
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Choose engine/runtime and mark policy explicitly at the competition root; children inherit. Failure never triggers another engine or policy.
decisions.rationale: Fallback would change numerical authority and destroy reproducible evidence.
decisions.consequences: Refuse unavailable/ineligible selections; retain identity/version/digest and require new authorized roots for different policy.

decisions.title: Offline race-day operation
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: MNEMEX supports pre-event validation and post-event reconciliation; pinned local show operation must not need MNEMEX availability during competition.
decisions.rationale: An identity service outage must not decide the show or make locked registrations unusable.
decisions.consequences: Validate online before import/roster lock, then use authorized local snapshots; queue results for later delivery.

decisions.title: Retain STRATHEX retro behavior
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Keep the existing retro CLI, Excel judge artifact, saves and existing V2/V3 pins working; managed mode is explicitly selected before legacy startup.
decisions.rationale: The owner expressly required preservation, and legacy startup has operator workbook/database side effects.
decisions.consequences: Use a separate selected interpreter for managed delegation and isolated storage for tests; do not rewrite normal startup into a different product.

decisions.title: Synthetic first bounded managed profile
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Qualify fresh synthetic single-run individual handicap SB/UH using the real packaged V2 predictor, configured wood, explicit Mark-3 policy and dual timers in Missoula.
decisions.rationale: A narrow real engine workflow is reviewable without claiming broader official eligibility.
decisions.consequences: Refuse existing history, partnered/dual/triple/shadow/live binding; production managed activation remains disabled.

decisions.title: Durable exact request retries and controlled editor handover
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Retain stable request ID, actor, exact payload/digest, expected revision and editor. Exact retries recover receipts; changed payloads conflict.
decisions.rationale: Response loss is ambiguous success, not permission to issue a second operation.
decisions.consequences: Recover original requests, refuse stale mutation and use explicit handover rather than concurrent independent editors.

decisions.title: Review and issue are separate commitments
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Forecast/proposed sheet, review, explicit issue, outcomes, judge acceptance and finalization are separate durable actions bound to exact field/sheet identity.
decisions.rationale: A number or reviewed draft is not authority to start or a final official result.
decisions.consequences: Changed preparation invalidates dependent unissued artifacts; preserve issued identity/history, use explicit correction revisions.

decisions.title: Progression recomputes field-relative marks
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Qualify entrants by configured rules and resolve boundary ties explicitly; each new field recalculates its own marks.
decisions.rationale: Start offsets depend on the exact competing field, not a portable athlete mark.
decisions.consequences: Never copy qualifying marks into a final or silently resolve judge ties by UI ordering.

decisions.title: Insert-only source creation ownership
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: An uncertain source create can only be adopted through its original source actor/request/config receipt; another candidate cannot replace it.
decisions.rationale: A later refused creation must not overwrite a successful but response-lost event or mapping.
decisions.consequences: Keep durable pending intents, source creation evidence and superseded-candidate conflicts; recovery may differ from the latest submitted candidate.

decisions.title: Monotonic locked host projection
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Reload under tournament/event locks, verify identity/config and move cached state/physical fields only forward in source revision.
decisions.rationale: Delayed responses retain their own receipts but must not overwrite a newer correction or fresh host facts.
decisions.consequences: Recheck wood for every config and current roster/divisions/gear before newer physical fields. Hold underlying PostgreSQL wood/competitor locks or the real host SQLite writer through commit, including uncoordinated writers. Receipt-only no-field forecast recovery publishes no physical heat. Protect scheduled/issued/started/completed fields.

decisions.title: Accept source export atomically through actual DB commit
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Hold the actual source fence through the host DBAPI commit; accept source attempts, career outbox, summary and receipt in one host transaction.
decisions.rationale: A subprocess verification that ends before commit leaves a race for later source revisions.
decisions.consequences: Refuse stale exports; preserve rollback/retry; batch source guards before host locks. Local coordination is not distributed hosted qualification.

decisions.title: Explicit host awards and correction reconciliation
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Host points/payouts use accepted current finalized source positions, current host registration and explicit award application; settlement is separate.
decisions.rationale: Accepting a correction must not silently pay, repay or leave a nonfinal event eligible for final awards.
decisions.consequences: Reopen host finalization on a nonfinal correction, preserve old award facts until deliberate reconciliation and rebuild college/team or pro totals.

decisions.title: Protect source-owned state from legacy writers
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Legacy score writes, scratch/deletion and gear repair must not mutate delegated fields/results; host-owned events continue to work.
decisions.rationale: Managed ownership would be meaningless if unrelated legacy writers could alter accepted source facts.
decisions.consequences: Guard global routes, college/team deletion, repairs and schedule writes; explicitly unschedule safe pending fields with digest binding before replacement.

decisions.title: Safe roster shrink preserves history
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: When adopting an unissued smaller roster, reconcile removed host placeholders only if they are empty pending results; any score/mark/award/settlement/reason history blocks deletion.
decisions.rationale: Ghost pending rows corrupt finalization, while deleting recorded zero timers or reviewed marks destroys history.
decisions.consequences: Verify and reconcile under host locks; a refused projection retains source intent for recovery instead of erasing facts.

decisions.title: Bounded supervised career delivery
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Deliver accepted source attempts/corrections through a durable bounded outbox to the explicit authenticated sandbox inbox, outside scoring/finalization.
decisions.rationale: MNEMEX downtime or committed-response loss must not block the show or duplicate career records.
decisions.consequences: Retain source/digest/receipt provenance, retry exact messages, reconcile conflicts and leave people unresolved without authorization.

decisions.title: Common count is start mark plus raw duration
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: common_count_completion = start_mark + raw_cutting_duration. Larger marks start later; raw duration remains raw evidence.
decisions.rationale: Owner reaffirmed the common-count start semantics; subtraction ranks the same performance incorrectly.
decisions.consequences: Sort common-count completion in handicap time scoring. Keep DNS/DNF/DQ, timer average, raw result and issue provenance separate.

decisions.title: Mark-3 is an explicit new policy
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Use integer mark = 3 + ceil(max_field_prediction - entrant_prediction), with allowed marks 3 through 180. Block out-of-range fields.
decisions.rationale: The approved Mark-3 conversion is deliberately distinct from retained optimizer behavior.
decisions.consequences: Do not compress/clamp to fit, substitute zero or alter the legacy optimizer policy. Marks are recalculated per field.

decisions.title: Retain legacy optimizer policy separately
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Retained V2 joint-optimizer/clipped historical behavior remains versioned separately; its historical maximum can be 183.
decisions.rationale: Compatibility and historical evidence cannot be silently rewritten to match the new Mark-3 policy.
decisions.consequences: Root policy identity must be visible in receipts; never treat a retained 183 ceiling as permission for managed marks above 180.

decisions.title: V2 predictor is real and numerical LLM workflow is retired
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Use the packaged V2 predictor and its supported evidence contract. Numeric LLM/council calculation is retired for V2.
decisions.rationale: The handover requires real reproducible numerical behavior, not mock values or speculative LLM adjustments.
decisions.consequences: Do not confuse V3 council/family architecture with permission to alter V2 or introduce an unavailable fallback.

decisions.title: Wood quality record-only for V2
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Accept supported known quality on 0–10 or null; record it but V2 does not change predictions for it. quality_sensitive is unsupported.
decisions.rationale: Evidence may retain context without claiming an unqualified numerical feature.
decisions.consequences: Never invent quality from a photo, coerce unknown to a meaningful zero or silently activate quality-sensitive calculations.

decisions.title: Prior-only reviewed evidence; no leakage
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Use only eligible reviewed SB/UH prior results at the declared cutoff; same-day, future and undated rows are not V2 prior evidence.
decisions.rationale: Prediction evaluation must not learn from the outcome it is predicting or broaden trust just because an archive contains a row.
decisions.consequences: Retain source dates/review/provenance; distinguish source outcomes from model training eligibility.

decisions.title: Distinct V3 runtime profiles
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Full Linux competition, unissued Linux preview and Windows full-factory/CNG are distinct exact contracts. Do not label all Linux V3 preview-only.
decisions.rationale: Runtime/engine eligibility is profile-specific and bound to source/digest/qualification.
decisions.consequences: Inspect CURRENT_RUNTIME_CONTRACT and producer V3 docs; managed v1 stays V2, Linux tests do not establish Windows CNG eligibility.

decisions.title: Retained zero is not managed minimum
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: An explicitly reviewed legacy zero start mark is valid and needs review evidence. Managed Mark-3 has minimum three.
decisions.rationale: Zero must not also mean no review; different policy roots have different domains.
decisions.consequences: Preserve mark_assigned_at/review state and never use default 0.0 as proof a late entrant was reviewed.

decisions.title: Synthetic evaluation proves only declared synthetic scope
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Keep the actual packaged-predictor synthetic evaluation: eight cases and four matched outcome sets, with runtime/source/data scope explicit.
decisions.rationale: Synthetic execution is useful portability/regression evidence, not real-world accuracy qualification.
decisions.consequences: Report metrics and unresolved limitations honestly; no private-history execution or training is implied.

decisions.title: Frozen prospective qualification remains blocked
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Require at least 100 genuinely later previously unexamined results from ten new competitions under the original frozen components.
decisions.rationale: Prospective evidence cannot be manufactured from examined old data or transferred to a different candidate by changing hashes.
decisions.consequences: Wait for real future observations; keep rc6 freeze and rc11 delivery separate; do not rehash artifacts to mark qualification passed.

decisions.title: Missoula canonical show contract wins
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Follow docs/DOMAIN_CONTRACT.md, then tests, FlightLogic, reconnaissance and historical requirements. Preserve the documented show behavior.
decisions.rationale: Older requirements/algorithm notes contain known contradictions and are not a new owner decision.
decisions.consequences: Record conflicts and governing corrections; never simplify sporting rules to fit shared operations.

decisions.title: Atomic whole-show scheduling
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Plan/validate complete show schedules using fresh inputs and publish atomically; invalid constraints reject without destroying the prior schedule.
decisions.rationale: Partial schedule mutation can strand competitors and invalidate issued/started state.
decisions.consequences: Preserve host show ordering, partner/run spacing, gear and capacity constraints; shared event operations do not reorder whole flights.

decisions.title: Physical stands and left-hand constraints
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Stock Saw uses stands 7/8 for both pro and college. Left-handed springboard uses its configured left-handed dummy (conventionally stand 4), at most once per heat; expand or reject invalid generation.
decisions.rationale: Later canonical corrections supersede older Stock Saw 1/2 and same-heat left-handed springboard overflow descriptions. This is a springboard-specific resource rule.
decisions.consequences: No same-heat invalid overflow or arbitrary resource expansion; validate source fields against actual configured stands.

decisions.title: Gear sharing is a hard scheduling constraint
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Normalize declarations/groups, respect valid event-specific sharing and physical concurrent limits, and reject impossible assignments before mutation.
decisions.rationale: Ignoring gear when everyone shares it does not make the schedule runnable.
decisions.consequences: Use canonical gear services and tests; managed fields are protected from legacy repair. Saw constraints remain per documented group/capacity.

decisions.title: College teams and points
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Teams have at most eight members with at least two of each gender; closed-event entry cap six, configurable open events, placement points 10/7/5/3/2/1.
decisions.rationale: These are the owner/canonical competition rules, not generic defaults to replace.
decisions.consequences: Split tied placement points as documented; rebuild individual/team aggregates after accepted changes; preserve pro vs college distinctions.

decisions.title: Pro shared-position purse
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Pro entrants sharing a position receive that position's configured amount each; do not split a single prize pool among them.
decisions.rationale: Host purse semantics differ from collegiate tie-point averaging.
decisions.consequences: Source positions drive explicit host awards; payout templates and settlement remain host-owned.

decisions.title: Dual stopwatches and raw facts
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Preserve two judge stopwatches per physical timed run and average per the documented policy; retain individual readings and raw duration.
decisions.rationale: Timing evidence and common-count placement are different facts.
decisions.consequences: Do not count absent/DNS/DNF/DQ as numeric zero; corrections retain issued/source identity and reviewer.

decisions.title: Partnered axe and normalized state
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Partnered Axe Throw keeps its documented prelim/final Event.event_state state machine; HeatAssignment and normalized relay/Birling tables are canonical for their domains.
decisions.rationale: Historical JSON roster/stand/Birling/relay stores have been removed or superseded by migrations.
decisions.consequences: Use Heat.set_roster and actual relationships; never recreate parallel stale JSON authority.

decisions.title: Pro-Am Relay lottery and program
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Relay teams have eight members: two each pro men/pro women/college men/college women; $5 lottery entry does not guarantee selection. Preserve four-event order and closing placement.
decisions.rationale: Relay mixes groups and has separate participation, money and show-program semantics.
decisions.consequences: Saw, Standing Butcher, Underhand Butcher, Team Axe Balloon; no college points, documented college prize-money exception; preserve Chokerman run-two closer.

decisions.title: Offline score submissions retain identity
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Offline score queues and replay use signed/context-bound receipts and explicit conflict handling, not an unauthenticated alternate scoring channel.
decisions.rationale: Offline operation must preserve the same authority, event/field context and duplicate protections as online entry.
decisions.consequences: Keep HMAC/session/event boundaries, replay receipts and judge confirmation; do not treat cached browser state as final authority.

decisions.title: Minors in the first pilot (owner option C)
decisions.authority: Explicit owner-approved D0 selection in S29; delivery scope separately tracked
decisions.decision: Support minors from the first pilot, with guardian and age-aware controls.
decisions.rationale: This is the owner's recorded selection, including choices that differ from the document's recommendation. Do not restart the options round.
decisions.consequences: Guardian authority, consent/revocation/retention and transition at adulthood are required; authentication alone does not verify guardianship.

decisions.title: Expanded legal identity (owner option B)
decisions.authority: Explicit owner-approved D0 selection in S29; delivery scope separately tracked
decisions.decision: Build the expanded legal-identity profile, separated from display/competitive identity.
decisions.rationale: This is the owner's recorded selection, including choices that differ from the document's recommendation. Do not restart the options round.
decisions.consequences: Encrypt private claims; do not expose legal/contact values to logs, public pages or ordinary show/numerical projections.

decisions.title: Opt-in public pages in the pilot (owner option B)
decisions.authority: Explicit owner-approved D0 selection in S29; delivery scope separately tracked
decisions.decision: Include per-person opt-in public profile pages in the intended pilot.
decisions.rationale: This is the owner's recorded selection, including choices that differ from the document's recommendation. Do not restart the options round.
decisions.consequences: Private is the default. Archive publication and a successful login do not make a person public.

decisions.title: MNEMEX-owned authentication (owner option C)
decisions.authority: Explicit owner-approved D0 selection in S29; delivery scope separately tracked
decisions.decision: Use MNEMEX's own account/UX boundary with maintained framework auth/crypto primitives.
decisions.rationale: This is the owner's recorded selection, including choices that differ from the document's recommendation. Do not restart the options round.
decisions.consequences: Account auth, person identity verification, guardian authority and partner grants remain independent.

decisions.title: Multiple shows from the start (owner option B)
decisions.authority: Explicit owner-approved D0 selection in S29; delivery scope separately tracked
decisions.decision: Support multiple shows from the first schema/tenancy design.
decisions.rationale: This is the owner's recorded selection, including choices that differ from the document's recommendation. Do not restart the options round.
decisions.consequences: Register tenant/client ownership, pairwise references, scoped credentials and revocation; do not retrofit global public correlation IDs.

decisions.title: Online validation before lock; offline afterward (owner option B)
decisions.authority: Explicit owner-approved D0 selection in S29; delivery scope separately tracked
decisions.decision: Use online-only package validation before import/roster lock, then a pinned local snapshot during the event.
decisions.rationale: This is the owner's recorded selection, including choices that differ from the document's recommendation. Do not restart the options round.
decisions.consequences: No race-day MNEMEX dependency or silent refresh of a locked roster; manual registration remains available.

decisions.title: Server-side atomic transaction (owner option A)
decisions.authority: Explicit owner-approved D0 selection in S29; delivery scope separately tracked
decisions.decision: Commit inbox/provenance/career-reconciliation/receipt/outbox effects in a server-side transaction.
decisions.rationale: This is the owner's recorded selection, including choices that differ from the document's recommendation. Do not restart the options round.
decisions.consequences: Do not approximate transactional authority with client-side chained writes; preserve exact retry and conflict receipts.

decisions.title: Recovery and retention before real PII (owner option A)
decisions.authority: Explicit owner-approved D0 selection in S29; delivery scope separately tracked
decisions.decision: Approve and prove recovery/retention obligations before ingesting real personally identifying data.
decisions.rationale: This is the owner's recorded selection, including choices that differ from the document's recommendation. Do not restart the options round.
decisions.consequences: RPO/RTO, DB/private-object/key restores and deletion/legal-hold behavior are required; local passing tests are insufficient.

decisions.title: Legacy bulk migration first (owner option B)
decisions.authority: Explicit owner-approved D0 selection in S29; delivery scope separately tracked
decisions.decision: Migrate legacy career sources through explicit bulk staging/quarantine/reconciliation before pilot legacy activation.
decisions.rationale: This is the owner's recorded selection, including choices that differ from the document's recommendation. Do not restart the options round.
decisions.consequences: Preserve originals, exact-digest approvals, review and resumable checkpoints; do not auto-link ambiguous names.

decisions.title: Integrated Django Results Desk on Railway/Supabase (owner option A)
decisions.authority: Explicit owner-approved D0 selection in S29; delivery scope separately tracked
decisions.decision: Use a single Django modular monolith with integrated Results Desk, hosted on Railway with Supabase PostgreSQL/private objects.
decisions.rationale: This is the owner's recorded selection, including choices that differ from the document's recommendation. Do not restart the options round.
decisions.consequences: Shared domain/migrations for web/workers; provider configuration/recovery remain explicit activation gates.

decisions.title: Broad result capture; narrow reviewed SB/UH export (owner option A)
decisions.authority: Explicit owner-approved D0 selection in S29; delivery scope separately tracked
decisions.decision: Archive broad results while keeping STRATHMARK 2.x evidence export restricted to reviewed eligible prior SB/UH.
decisions.rationale: This is the owner's recorded selection, including choices that differ from the document's recommendation. Do not restart the options round.
decisions.consequences: Archive coverage does not widen numeric eligibility, consent, trust or discipline support.

decisions.title: Automatic valid-source publication (owner option C)
decisions.authority: Explicit owner-approved D0 selection in S29; delivery scope separately tracked
decisions.decision: Automatically publish deterministic-valid uploaded rows to the private archive.
decisions.rationale: This is the owner's recorded selection, including choices that differ from the document's recommendation. Do not restart the options round.
decisions.consequences: Identity reconciliation, verification/trust, public visibility, consent and STRATHMARK eligibility remain separate review states.

decisions.title: Immutable opaque Person identity
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Use an opaque immutable person ID distinct from account, email, name, federation ID, pairwise show reference and numerical pseudonym.
decisions.rationale: Names and accounts change; correlation and legal identity have different disclosure/authority boundaries.
decisions.consequences: Never recycle IDs or silently name-link people; merge/split/redact preserves provenance and tombstones.

decisions.title: Purpose-scoped grants and portable projections
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Portable profiles require explicit recipient/show/purpose/field scope, approval/version, expiry/revocation and retention acknowledgment; projected packages bind issuer/audience/digest/context.
decisions.rationale: A profile is a scoped projection, not a replica of legal identity or a universal bearer credential.
decisions.consequences: Validate before import/lock, retain exact receipt/digest/local mapping, respect revocation for future disclosure and keep manual registration.

decisions.title: Source archive preserves extraction provenance
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Preserve original artifacts/digests, selected sheet/row/cell, parser/mapping version, operator/reviewer, validation, correction and supersession.
decisions.rationale: Extracted rows are evidence of a source, not inherently verified person facts.
decisions.consequences: Multi-sheet XLSX requires explicit selection; LLM outputs are untrusted and cannot invent source values; conflicts quarantine.

decisions.title: Narrow sandbox receiver is implemented; full portability is not
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: mnemex.show-result.v1 accepts registered source-attributed immutable attempts/corrections and receipts, leaving identities unresolved.
decisions.rationale: The bounded real receiver validates integration without pretending all portable-profile features or production activation are done.
decisions.consequences: Do not create Person/career/public links automatically or write directly to host scoring tables.

decisions.title: Scoped machine identity and immutable correction stream
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Enforce source/client ownership, expiring revocable hashed credentials, issued-field/entry binding, immutable payload digests and contiguous correction predecessors.
decisions.rationale: An alternate message ID must not bypass a changed source revision conflict or poison another stream.
decisions.consequences: Exact retries recover receipts; out-of-order revisions wait; retain conflict and authenticating-credential provenance; unknown historical attribution stays null.

decisions.title: Maintained authentication and fresh privileged actions
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Use Django/allauth, Argon2id, verified email, privileged TOTP/recovery, session rotation/revocation, eight-hour privileged freshness and five-minute sensitive-POST freshness.
decisions.rationale: The approved own-auth choice does not mean inventing cryptography or skipping action-specific authorization.
decisions.consequences: Sensitive tickets bind route/origin/session/method/account/security version; in-page step-up preserves form/files and requires explicit confirmation.

decisions.title: Queue-only security mail
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Security notifications create encrypted durable intents and use bounded fenced workers; the request path does not fall back to SMTP.
decisions.rationale: Owner approved queue-only after availability implications were disclosed; unknown handoff must be reviewed rather than blindly duplicated.
decisions.consequences: Retain event-time verified recipients, deterministic identity, retries, leases and uncertain-handoff evidence. Hosted SMTP/recovery proofs remain open.

decisions.title: Recover DB, private artifacts and historical keys together
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Recovery includes DB, private objects, versioned encryption keys and reconciled inventory, not only a database backup.
decisions.rationale: A restored row is unusable if its private evidence or required historical key is absent.
decisions.consequences: Keep key retirement blockers, resumable re-encryption, artifact leases/orphan reconciliation and independent provider recovery proofs.

decisions.title: Production privileged activation stays hard-disabled
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: All fourteen activation gates remain unclosed; a registry/report/offline signature verifier cannot enable production privilege.
decisions.rationale: Local CI cannot prove hosted configuration, provider recovery, independent operators or custody.
decisions.consequences: No environment toggle shortcut or implied live pilot. Follow G01–G14 evidence and operator ceremonies.

decisions.title: Repository process with precise source evidence
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Commit/push/merge verified changes through each repository's permitted PR process, preserving exact head/main/CI/review/artifact and failure receipts.
decisions.rationale: Merged, published, activated and verified are different states; a later commit does not inherit an exact-head result.
decisions.consequences: Fetch before edits, isolate baselines, record skips and cleanup, do not bypass branch protection or erase failures.

decisions.title: Missoula backup/key proofs block merge
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Keep the feature draft/unmerged until exact-current-branch hosted read-only backup/restore/encrypted-artifact proof and separately held recovery-identity decryption/restore rehearsal exist.
decisions.rationale: The branch advances the backup Alembic expectation and main automatically deploys/migrates; the repository release checklist explicitly requires these proofs.
decisions.consequences: No production workflow dispatch, gate bypass, schema-pin removal or merge merely because CI is green. Authorized operators must supply the exact proofs.

decisions.title: No private data or numerical requalification by implication
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Routine implementation authorization does not authorize private historical training/runs, operational data tests, official activation or changing frozen qualification artifacts.
decisions.rationale: Availability of credentials/data is not the owner's permission for a new operational use.
decisions.consequences: Use synthetic isolated proof, keep NOT_RUN/BLOCKED explicit and request only the specific genuinely required external input when needed.

decisions.title: Model-neutral memory stored in MNEMEX Git
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Store a thorough cross-repository handoff in MNEMEX Markdown/JSON/source snapshots with a single entry point and offline search/context/integrity tooling.
decisions.rationale: The owner wants to switch harness/model without rebuilding hours of context; implemented MNEMEX has no general project-memory ingest API.
decisions.consequences: Link AGENTS/CLAUDE/README; avoid Django/database dependency, keep decisions/rationale/status/sources and preserve the coverage limit on unseen conversations.

decisions.title: Technical memory is separate from person/career data
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: Do not put design decisions into Person, consent, source-result or career tables or pretend this pack is an application memory endpoint.
decisions.rationale: The technical handoff has different semantics and disclosure rules from competitor data.
decisions.consequences: No PII/keys/credentials/datasets in the pack; source snapshots are dated reference, current user/repository instructions still govern.

decisions.title: Historical-only scraper and JSONL canonical store retired
decisions.authority: Owner-approved handover and/or cited maintained contract
decisions.decision: The old historical-only scraper/static archive/JSONL-git canonical design is superseded by the approved universal profile service and integrated Desk.
decisions.rationale: August 14 owner selections changed product scope and transactional requirements.
decisions.consequences: Do not resurrect the retired scheduled production exporter; legacy JSONL may remain an explicit compatibility/export surface.
